title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Payment of Cancellation Refunds
content:
**Timing and form.** A computed cancellation refund on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract is paid within the coverage level's refund payment days, counted in calendar days after the cancellation is processed. It is paid in one payment for the full amount due.

**Payee.** Where the coverage level pays refunds on financed contracts to the lienholder, and the contract record shows the contract was financed on the installment contract, the refund is paid to the lienholder named on the contract. Otherwise it is paid to the holder.

**Zero refunds and repeat payments.**
- A refund of 0.00 is not paid.
- A refund is paid only once per refund calculation. The contract's claim and refund history shows whether a payment already points at that calculation.

| Refund due (hypothetical) | Financed on the installment contract | Paid to |
|---|---|---|
| 1184.37 | yes | the lienholder named on the contract, in one payment |
| 1184.37 | no | the holder, in one payment |
| 0.00 | either | nothing is paid |

**Example of the window (hypothetical).** With refund payment days of 30, a cancellation processed on a given day is paid no later than the 30th calendar day after it.
